_note: Example per-repo product config. Lives at each product repo's root as .commonstage.json. Strict JSON (RFC 8259) per CommonMind/data-format-doctrine.md — no comments; annotate in _note fields. Consumed for the repo's product page; the org config (site.json) does NOT restate any of this.
name: CommonStage
tagline: The shared web presentation layer — the standard, templates, styling, and generator behind every Org and product page.

status.detail: Design stage · early: two proving sites, apparatus extracted, generator not built

description: CommonStage is the shared web presentation layer. This very site is built with it. It is at the design stage: the shape is settled and the first pages exist as hand-built proofs, but the reusable generator has not been extracted yet. Shown here honestly as work in progress — never dressed up as finished.
